aggregation.batch: For each tree and variant: median of per-call batch means; deterministic counters counted once.
aggregation.random_family: For each tree: median across random orders; then aggregate independent trees within source and depth.
aggregation.paired: Calculate each random-order/original ratio per tree first, median these ratios within the tree, then aggregate trees. Not ratios of family or group medians.
aggregation.sample_size: Random permutations are nested repeats; 30 trees x 10 orders remains 30 independent input trees per depth.
aggregation.time_scope: search excludes full validation; query includes validation; total includes fresh copying, full exact-value preprocessing if ideal, ordering, query and loop/result handling.
aggregation.uncertainty: Q1-Q3 are linearly interpolated across-tree dispersion, not confidence intervals.
aggregation.oracle: Exact-value order is an oracle reference; full true-value preparation is charged on every timed call.

paired.order_comparisons_note: Nested orders on the same trees; these are not independent tree samples.
